versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-douyin-content-research:

- Supports Douyin (TikTok China) data research: keyword search, competitor analysis, comment insights, and trending topics tracking.
- Provides four main functions: content/author keyword search, batch creator post scraping, video comment analysis, and real-time hotlist queries.
- No Douyin login required; does not support publishing, downloading, or account operation.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Designed for short video research, competitive tracking, content planning, and trend monitoring.
